audit.whatIsWrong: diff reads FAV but report[14] calls it an 'Even matchup', and the tone colour is the even-yellow rather than the favoured-green used on other FAV pages.
audit.why: 56.49% over 1078 games supports FAV. The page argued with itself in the one line a player reads last.
audit.corrected: report[14].t changed to 'Favoured matchup'. diff, diffRating and tone left as they are so the mirror is not disturbed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven chart rows disagreed with the mirror and the packet: Level 1 Skill, Level 2 Poppy, Level 3 Poppy, Levels 4-5 Skill, Level 6 Skill, First item Poppy.
audit.why: Mirror point 2 flipped rows 0-5 as matched pairs and raised the Level 6 rating to a Jax row, landing on the packet chart. Every one of Poppy's whys already described that chart — whys[0] 'deny his only level-1 aggression', whys[1] 'Even window', whys[2] 'Roughly even', whys[3] 'You out-trade here', whys[4] 'Jax spikes at 6', whys[5] 'a clean even-or-better trade'. Only the side tokens were wrong.
audit.corrected: phases[0..5].side and win[0..5] flipped as one group, with Level 1 raised to 6/10 and Level 6 dropped to 3/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors. (a) The page calls Steadfast Presence a permanent counter to Leap Strike — 'W blocks his Q gap-close', 'W is a permanent hard counter to his Q engage', 'his dash either gets blocked or he gets grounded'. The dash-stop is the 20/18/16/14/12s ACTIVE; Leap Strike is 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s, so he leaps roughly twice per W. (b) The decisive interaction was missing entirely: Keeper's Verdict is a channel and a Counter Strike recast cancels it.
audit.why: The mirror agent found the same aura error and added the same R-channel interrupt from the other side. Telling a player their W permanently answers Jax is what gets them killed pressing a 140-second ultimate into a raised Counter Strike.
audit.corrected: Both cooldowns stated in tldr, tradeGood, dontsFull[2].d, phases[1].why, whys[6], wants.you[1], mid, late and breakdown.cooldowns; the channel cancel stated in phases[4].why, mid and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Counter Strike was described only as 'Dodges autos + stuns. Bait it.' with no cooldown, and the page never distinguished dodging attacks from dodging abilities.
audit.why: Counter Strike is 17/15/13/11/9s at 300 range and dodges all incoming attacks for its duration before stunning. That 17 seconds at rank 1 is the largest punish window in the lane and it was never quantified.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d, tradeGood, late and breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: This is the rare scaler matchup where you keep the edge — your W is a permanent hard counter to his Q engage, so even as Jax itemizes you can press the side lane and ground every attempt to leap on you. Trade only when his E Counter Strike is down, chunk with Q, and slam him off the wave with E into terrain. Don't duel into a fed Jax with R up and E raised, but your dash-denial means he can never cleanly catch you — keep denying and your team takes over.
edits.after: This is the rare scaler matchup where you keep the edge — Steadfast Presence grounds Leap Strike, so even as Jax itemizes you can press the side lane. But it is 20 seconds to his 8: you deny the leap you choose, not every one. Trade only when Counter Strike (17s) is down, chunk with Q, and slam him off the wave with E into terrain. Don't duel a fed Jax with his ultimate up and Counter Strike raised — keep denying and your team takes over.

notes: Name conflict left unresolved on purpose: the packet's enemyAbilities lists Jax's R as 'Grandmaster-at-Arms', while the mirror agent's audit of jax__poppy says it corrected three fields to 'Grandmaster's Might'. Both cannot be right and the kit file is the stated authority, so I did not name his ultimate anywhere on this page — every reference is 'his ultimate'. It needs settling before either page names it, because the two pages will otherwise print different names for the same spell. Also confirming the mirror's data note: champ-data/_kits/jax.json flags Empower (W) with 'dash'. Riot's text is 'Jax charges his weapon with energy, causing his next attack to deal additional damage' — no movement at all. It is an auto-attack reset and nothing else, so W does not stop it; I wrote no advice from that flag.
